questions.question_text: Original Practice Question — A courier starts at O and walks north 5 km, then east 6 km, then south 3 km, then west 4 km. What are the endpoint coordinates relative to the starting point, taking east and north as positive?
questions.explanation: East-west displacement is +2 km and north-south displacement is +2 km after cancelling opposite legs, so the endpoint coordinates are (+2, +2) km (east, north coordinates).

questions.question_text: Original Practice Question — A courier starts at O and walks west 6 km, then south 7 km, then east 3 km, then north 2 km. What are the endpoint coordinates relative to the starting point, taking east and north as positive?

questions.question_text: Original Practice Question — A courier starts at O and walks east 6 km, then north 12 km, then west 2 km, then south 4 km. How far is the endpoint from the starting point in a straight line?
questions.explanation: After cancelling opposite legs the net components are 4 km and 8 km. The shortest distance is √(4² + 8²) = 8.94 km.
